Starlink grows customers for airlines

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: DogeDesigner (@cb_doge); megjelent: 2026-11-03T16:06:56+00:00; link: https://x.com/cb_doge/status/2117649738623496227; média: 1 kép]
BREAKING: Starlink helped Japan’s ZIPAIR grow passenger revenue 12.3% YoY.

Japan Airlines (JAL) says @Starlink improved ZIPAIR’s onboard experience and helped drive revenue growth alongside flexible pricing. 

ZIPAIR became Asia’s first airline with Starlink across its entire fleet in May. April–September passenger revenue reached ¥42.9 billion, while seat occupancy jumped from 73.7% to 87.8%.
